receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt in 'Dundee Courier' - Saturday 4 June 1898
receipts.receiptText: Isle of Wight Pudding.- Three ounces of butter, quarter-pound of flour, half teaspoonful of baking powder, one ounce of dried cherries three ounces of sugar, three eggs, three ounces of almonds, one ounce citron. Butter a mould, ornament with cherries and the citron cut into fancy shapes. Beat the butter to a cream, add the sugar, beat eggs, add them and the flour alternately to butter and sugar, add baking powder, and almonds blanched and shredded; beat all well together, put the mixture into the mould, cover with a greased paper. Steam. Serve with lemon sauce.
